retryIdentity: Shared wakeAttemptKey binds initial or completed LRQ identity and a stable descendant-ID set digest; descendant IDs accept launch_request_id, launchRequestId, then id. retryOfLaunchRequestId records one re-wake per reconciled retryable no-merge attempt. Recovery wake keys use deadline.anchoredAt, then deadline.at, then the explicit unanchored sentinel for their anchor component.
